lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill region; a primary column contains four distinct centroids aligned vertically in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like structure across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible with a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient—characterized by light upper edges and shadowed lower edges—extending across the mid-lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized dark circular mark is visible on the flank superior to the pectoral fin base; the pectoral fin trailing edge shows non-uniform, irregular serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region and a dense school of smaller fish positioned directly beneath the ventral midline.
